focus: knowledge and memory layer (NotebookLM, Mem.ai, Workspace Studio, R2 as system of record)
hydrator_prompt: Keep the LEDGER pool at >=15 waiting tasks focused on the knowledge/memory layer: NotebookLM (official Enterprise API + unofficial notebooklm-py), Mem.ai inflows, Google Workspace Studio flows, and R2 as the durable system of record. Reality anchors: Mem's outflow/OAuth is not fully shipped (treat Mem as a write sink); notebooklm-py uses undocumented endpoints (fragile, personal-use). Check depth: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_pool WHERE instance_target='ledger' AND status='waiting'. If <15, generate 10 specific IMPLEMENTATION tasks. Priority 20-60. Insert, re-queue yourself priority 1, log pool.hydrated.

tasks.name: notebooklm-py-setup
tasks.prompt: Install and wire notebooklm-py (PyPI, MIT, unofficial). Authenticate, then script: create notebook, add sources (URL/YouTube/PDF/Drive/text), list/rename/delete. Build a thin CLI wrapper. IMPORTANT: mark clearly in code+docs that this uses undocumented Google endpoints that can break without notice — personal/prototype use only, never a production dependency. Document setup + auth.

tasks.name: notebooklm-artifact-pipeline
tasks.prompt: Build an artifact-generation pipeline on notebooklm-py: from a set of sources, generate Audio Overview (MP3), Video Overview (MP4), slide deck (PPTX), infographic (PNG), quiz/flashcards (JSON), and mind map (JSON), then batch-download all artifacts to R2 under a dated prefix. These export formats aren't available in the web UI. Document the pipeline and where outputs land.

tasks.name: notebooklm-enterprise-api
tasks.prompt: Set up the OFFICIAL NotebookLM Enterprise API (Google Cloud) as the stable path for notebook + source management. Compare its surface to notebooklm-py. Use the official API for anything that must be reliable (notebook create, source batch-add). Document auth (GCP service account/OAuth), quotas, and which operations to route to official vs unofficial.

tasks.name: workspace-studio-notebooklm-flows
tasks.prompt: Build Google Workspace Studio flows that use NotebookLM as a grounded knowledge source (available in Studio as of May 2026). Create a flow: 'Ask Gemini' step with list-format output feeding a 'Repeat for each' step that loops Google Sheet rows. Ground responses in a notebook. Document the flow and admin step-allowlist settings.

tasks.name: mem-inflow-capture
tasks.prompt: Build a capture pipeline into Mem.ai using the inflow API (creating 'mem' entities). Sources: quick notes, Slack saved items, email highlights, worker events. Treat Mem as a WRITE-ONLY sink for now (outflow/OAuth not fully shipped). Timestamp + tag each mem. Do not build anything that depends on reading the Mem graph back out programmatically. Document the inflow auth and payload shape.

tasks.name: mem-outflow-stub
tasks.prompt: Stub the Mem outflow/OAuth integration for when it ships. Write an adapter interface (get_related, search_graph, sync_out) with a clear NOT-YET-AVAILABLE guard that fails safe. When Mem's outflow endpoints + Flow Store go live, only this adapter changes. Document the interface and the trigger conditions to activate it.

tasks.name: r2-system-of-record
tasks.prompt: Make R2 the durable system of record for all knowledge. Define the bucket layout (sources/, artifacts/, notebooks/, mem-mirror/ under dated prefixes). Every artifact generated by NotebookLM or captured to Mem also lands in R2 with metadata (source, created, sha256). R2 survives even if NotebookLM/Mem endpoints break. Document the canonical layout and metadata schema.

tasks.name: knowledge-sync-glue
tasks.prompt: Build the glue that keeps R2 <-> NotebookLM <-> Mem consistent, with R2 authoritative. On new source in R2: register it in NotebookLM (official API) and capture a summary mem to Mem (inflow). On artifact generation: mirror to R2. Idempotent, delta-based (track a cursor/manifest in R2 or D1). Document the sync contract and conflict rule (R2 wins).

tasks.name: gemini-notebook-bridge
tasks.prompt: Leverage the April-2026 NotebookLM<->Gemini app integration (bidirectional sync). Document how notebooks surface in the Gemini app, how to push a notebook's sources for Video Overviews/infographics/audio, and design a workflow where research done in Gemini lands back in a notebook and then R2. Implement whatever is scriptable; document the manual steps.

tasks.name: knowledge-search-cli
tasks.prompt: Build a local knowledge-search CLI over the R2 system-of-record: index titles/metadata/text of everything in the knowledge buckets, expose `knowledge-search <query>` with ranking. Add semantic search if embeddings are available (via AI Gateway). This gives you a fast, endpoint-independent way to find anything, even if NotebookLM/Mem are down. Document usage.
